rows.owner_rationale: IR contract is central to parser/lowering/runtime compatibility and needs explicit parity.
rows.test_expectation: Core IR is 0.13.0 and engine IR is 0.14.0. Engine 0.5.0, 0.8.0 through 0.11.0, and 0.13.0 are deliberately skipped because they identify incompatible core wires; core 0.6.0, 0.7.0, and 0.12.0 are explicitly rejected because they identify incompatible engine wires. bd-b12xs.6 widened Ir1PropertyKey::Static to JsString; bd-0k19b added engine-only LoadName, PutName, ResolveNameStatus, and PutNameWithStatus operations at 0.6.0; bd-g73mg added IteratorCloseReason::Continue to engine 0.7.0. bd-t9n3s adds Continue to core 0.8.0 plus labelled lowering, runtime IteratorClose completion handling, and ordinary-JavaScript donor/oracle parity. bd-uhf1m advances core to 0.9.0 with optional exact metadata for captured body-local let/const bindings so deferred lowering preserves TDZ, const, and initialization semantics. bd-093id advances core to 0.10.0 with the serialized GeneratorBodyStart boundary in IR1, IR2, and IR3 so generator invocation runs parameter initialization before suspending ahead of the body. bd-ppfz7 advances core to 0.11.0 and engine to 0.12.0 with authenticated derived-constructor registration and ConstructSuper operations in IR1 and IR3. bd-gqaa4 advances core to 0.13.0 and engine to 0.14.0 with explicit DefineMethod operations, private per-closure method identity, and HomeObject semantics; each lane skips the peer-owned preceding minor. Schema, feature-introduction, and boundary gates reject malformed current, unsupported, or historically versioned artifacts carrying newer operations, while supported legacy artifacts without newer operations remain readable. Ownership remains unsettled.
